g.text: Weak scaling · fixed permutations per worker

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Each worker receives exactly n inputs after CI sharding. A flat runtime is ideal weak scaling; deadline stops are not completed timings.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #475569

g.text: Can runtime stay steady as both workers and total work increase? Each worker receives the same number of inputs.
